Cutting.description:
One tested way to cut with a tool: the values an operation takes from a row of the
tool's cutting data (docs/specs/cutting-data.md §2, §3).

feed.description: The feed of a cut at a stepover (a pocket's rings), mm/min.

rpm.description: Spindle speed, rpm. Null: the tool's own.

slot_feed.description: The feed of a full-width cut (a profile, a pocket's first ring), mm/min.

slot_step_down.description: The step down of a full-width cut, mm.

step_down.description: The step down of a cut at a stepover, mm.

stepover.description: Pocket stepover, a fraction of the tool diameter: more than 0, at most 1.

CuttingRow.description: A row of a tool's cutting data: the values for one material, or for any material.

material_uid.description:
The material's uid (`materials.json`). Null: any material, the row used without a
material or when the tool has no row for it.

LibraryTool.description: One tool of the library: a project tool with a name and optional cutting values.

angle.description: V-bits: the included angle, radians. Null: unknown.

center_cutting.description: Whether it can plunge straight down. Null: unknown.

cutting_data.description:
The cutting data: one row per material, and one for any material
(docs/specs/cutting-data.md §2). What an operation takes when a material is chosen,
its tool changes or it is added. Missing: none.

id.description: The tool number it gets in a project, when that number is free there.

name.description: The tool's name, unique in the library (upper or lower case don't matter).

tip_diameter.description: V-bits: the flat tip's diameter, mm. Null: pointed.

uid.description:
What projects link the tool by: 16 lowercase hex digits, unique in the library, never
changed (docs/specs/library-in-browser.md §2).

oneOf.description:
A ball nose, plain or tapered (docs/specs/stl-relief.md §8): for reliefs and follow
paths only.

description: Schema version 4. Older files load through Chipload's migrations; this schema describes only the current version.

default_tool.description: The name of the tool new projects start with. Null: the built-in 6 mm endmill.

schema_version.description: The version of the file format. Chipload upgrades older files when it reads them, and refuses newer ones.

written_by.description: The Chipload version that wrote the file.

title: Chipload tool library
